scope: Ports, required runtime variables, persistence, dependency topology and first-run checks for all 52 OSS recipes.
limits: Schema/admission validation is separate from upstream semantic review.
These recipes have not all been deployed end to end.
Pinned versions are examples, not a claim that every tag is the latest release.
Upstream URLs and future releases can change; review compatibility before upgrading.
